sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"问题怎样被改写","en":"Reframing the problem"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"McCulloch 与 Pitts 把神经活动中的“全或无”特征转写为命题逻辑。论文同时考虑两个方向：给定网络怎样描述它的行为；给定满足条件的逻辑表达式，又怎样构造相应网络。这种双向关系使神经元既成为研究对象，也成为一种计算形式。","en":"McCulloch and Pitts translated the all-or-none character of neural activity into propositional logic. Their argument runs in two directions: describing the behaviour of a given network, and constructing a network for an admissible logical expression. Neurons become both objects of investigation and elements of a computational formalism."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"模型的边界","en":"What the model does not establish"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"循环网络需要更复杂的逻辑处理；不同生理假设下的网络也可能给出相同结果，却耗费不同时间。论文的论证不能当作真实大脑的完整复制，更没有展示自动生成艺术作品。","en":"Networks containing cycles require more elaborate logical treatment. Networks built under different physiological assumptions may yield equivalent results, although their timing differs. This formal equivalence is not a complete reproduction of an actual brain, and the paper does not demonstrate the generation of artworks."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-3","heading":{"zh":"为什么进入艺术史","en":"Why it belongs in this history"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：这一节点提供的是认知可被形式化的思想条件。把它与后来的神经图像生成并读，可以追问从逻辑单元到学习参数之间发生了什么变化，而不是把 1943 年直接宣称为 AI 艺术的诞生。","en":"Editorial interpretation: the connection is the formalisation of cognition. Reading this paper alongside later neural image synthesis raises a question about the movement from logical units to learned parameters; it does not establish 1943 as the birth of AI art."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"通信的数学问题","en":"The mathematical problem of communication"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"香农研究消息如何经过有噪声的信道传输，将信源、编码、传输和接收组织为一个可分析的系统。概率分布决定信息的不确定性，冗余则与可靠传输有关。论文发表于1948年；与韦弗合编的1949年书籍是另一个出版层次，不能合并成同一日期。","en":"Shannon treats communication as the transmission of messages through a potentially noisy channel, separating source, encoding, transmission and reception. Probability supplies a measure of uncertainty; redundancy matters to reliable transmission. The 1948 paper and the 1949 volume with Weaver are distinct publication events."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"信息美学的边界","en":"The boundary of information aesthetics"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"这一框架为讨论图像的秩序、变化和重复提供了可计算的词汇，但通信系统中的信息量不能直接衡量一件作品的文化价值。将本条与本泽、莫尔斯并读，可以追问工程概念如何被移入美学，而不是把数学通信理论等同于一套完成的艺术理论。","en":"The framework supplies a calculable vocabulary for order, variation and repetition in images. Yet a communication measure does not by itself measure cultural value. Reading Shannon alongside Bense and Moles makes the movement of engineering concepts into aesthetics a historical question, rather than treating communication theory as an already complete theory of art."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"通信进入控制回路","en":"Communication inside a control loop"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Wiener 在 1948 年把信息传递和行为调节放到同一理论框架中：系统发出信息，接收回应，再据此调整行动。出版社所列章节跨越时间序列、反馈与振荡、计算机和神经系统、语言与社会，显示这不是一本仅讨论某种设备的操作手册。","en":"In 1948 Wiener connected information transmission with the regulation of behaviour: a system sends messages, receives responses and adjusts its activity. Chapters range across time series, feedback and oscillation, computing and the nervous system, and language and society. The project extends beyond the operation of any particular device."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"原版与增补版","en":"Distinguishing editions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"现行书目同时收录 1948 年原版和 1961 年增补章节。有关学习、自我复制机器与自组织系统的后两章属于后者，不能因为它们出现在同一本再版书中，就全部标成 1948 年的论述。","en":"The current edition combines the 1948 book with supplementary chapters from 1961. The later material on learning, self-reproducing machines and self-organising systems should not all be assigned to 1948 merely because it appears in one modern volume."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-3","heading":{"zh":"从互动装置到控制权","en":"From interactive installations to control"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：反馈让我们看到作品、观众和环境之间可以形成持续关系。它也提示研究者区分“系统怎样调节行为”与“谁有权设定目标”。前者是机制，后者牵涉制度和政治，二者不能直接等同。","en":"Editorial interpretation: feedback helps describe continuing relations among an artwork, its audience and its environment. It also distinguishes how a system regulates behaviour from who is entitled to specify its goals. A mechanism of control is not itself an explanation of political authority."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"细胞集群与学习","en":"Cell assemblies and learning"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"赫布的1949年著作把行为解释与脑的生理组织联系起来，以细胞集群讨论知觉和心理概念如何获得物质基础。麦吉尔大学对其工作的回顾强调共同活动的细胞之间联系增强的学习思路。这里讨论的是神经心理理论，并非一台已经能够作画的机器。","en":"Hebb’s 1949 book connects explanations of behaviour with the physiological organisation of the brain. Cell assemblies provide a proposed material basis for perceptions and mental concepts. McGill’s account emphasises learning through strengthened connections among co-active cells. This is a neuropsychological theory, not a machine that was already making pictures."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"经验如何成为结构","en":"How experience becomes structure"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"在艺术史谱系中，本条有助于区分两种制作观念：预先写好的指令，以及随经验形成的内部联系。它为讨论学习系统提供思想背景，但不能据此声称每一种后来的神经艺术都直接来自赫布，也不能把生物神经的解释与软件训练机制完全等同。","en":"Within this genealogy, the entry distinguishes prewritten instructions from internal relationships formed through experience. It provides intellectual context for learning systems without proving that every later neural artwork directly descends from Hebb. Biological explanation and software training also remain different levels of description."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"模仿游戏的设置","en":"Setting up the imitation game"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"图灵没有先给“思考”下一个完备定义，而是提出由隔离的询问者通过文字交谈进行判断的游戏。把身体、声音和外貌排除出去，是实验条件的一部分。论文还讨论数字计算机、反对意见和学习机器，因此不能把全文缩成一项后来被称为“图灵测试”的简单合格证。","en":"Turing replaces a demand for an exhaustive definition of thinking with a game in which an interrogator judges through written exchanges. Excluding bodily appearance and voice is part of the experimental arrangement. The paper also considers digital computers, objections and learning machines; it is more than a simple certificate later called the Turing test."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"创作的判断条件","en":"Conditions for judging creativity"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"艺术中的相关问题不只是谁生成了一张图，还包括观众被允许知道什么、作品如何被展示，以及评价标准由谁制定。机器能否在某种判断程序中成功，与它是否具有人的经验并非同一结论。这个区分帮助避免把逼真的输出直接当作创造主体存在的证据。","en":"For art, the relevant question includes what viewers are allowed to know, how a work is presented and who establishes the criteria. Success within a procedure does not establish human experience. This distinction helps prevent convincing output from being treated automatically as evidence of a creative subject."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"棋局作为实验环境","en":"The game as an experimental environment"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"塞缪尔以跳棋研究机器学习。IBM对项目的回顾描述了从棋局经验中改进判断的程序，以及用机器对弈获得经验的做法。有限的棋盘、规则和胜负条件构成可比较的实验环境；这与开放的艺术评价不同，不能直接将赢棋视为创造力的通用尺度。","en":"Samuel investigates machine learning through checkers. sections: [{"id":"origins","heading":{"zh":"从画室到人工智能实验室","en":"From the studio to the AI laboratory"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"AARON 不是某一年发布的一款固定产品。惠特尼美术馆把它的构想追溯到 Cohen 在加州大学圣迭戈分校工作的 1960 年代末；1973—1975 年，他又在斯坦福人工智能实验室继续开发。区分构想、命名与后续版本，比把漫长的实践压成一个“诞生年份”更能说明这项工作的性质。","en":"AARON was a developing artistic project rather than a fixed product launched on one date. The Whitney traces its conception to Cohen’s work at the University of California, San Diego, in the late 1960s, followed by development at Stanford’s Artificial Intelligence Laboratory in 1973–75. Conception, naming and later implementations belong to different moments."}],"sourceIds":["whitney-art","whitney-overview"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"knowledge","heading":{"zh":"编码的是绘画判断","en":"Encoding decisions about drawing"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"程序需要处理轮廓是否封闭、图形与背景怎样区分、对象如何分布等问题。惠特尼的作品说明举出先画前景再处理背景的规则，也说明程序结合随机事件安排线条和形状。这里的生成不是把某张预先保存的成品描一遍；Cohen 要表达的是一套在绘制过程中不断作决定的方法。","en":"The program had to deal with closed contours, figure and ground, and the distribution of objects. The Whitney describes rules such as working from foreground to background, combined with random events that generate lines and shapes. The drawing emerges through successive decisions rather than the tracing of a stored finished picture."}],"sourceIds":["whitney-art"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"learning","heading":{"zh":"1982 年的自述：它并不从画完的作品中学习","en":"A limitation Cohen described in 1982"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"在《How to Make a Drawing》中，Cohen 说明当时的 AARON 能记住正在进行的绘画，却不会把画完一张画的经验积累为下一张的新知识。他也回忆自己为程序的线描着色，并把自己的位置理解为教师与合作者之间。这些话针对该文讨论的阶段，不能不加区分地套用到此后所有版本。","en":"In How to Make a Drawing, Cohen explains that the AARON he is discussing remembers a drawing in progress but does not accumulate experience from completed drawings. He also recalls colouring its line drawings himself and understanding his role as somewhere between teacher and collaborator. sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"历史对象与具体过程","en":"Historical object and process"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"ICA资料记载，Jasia Reichardt策划的Cybernetic Serendipity于1968年8月2日至10月20日举行，Franciszka Themerson负责展览设计。参与者来自作曲、工程、艺术、数学与诗歌等领域。这里的共同点是艺术与新系统的相遇，不是所有展品都使用同一种计算机或人工智能方法。","en":"ICA records date Jasia Reichardt’s Cybernetic Serendipity to 2 August–20 October 1968, with exhibition design by Franciszka Themerson. limits.en: Institutional records and exhibition accounts were read; the complete programs and original diaries were not examined. The NGA inscription discrepancy remains unresolved; the V&A exhibition had not opened at the check date.
limits.zh: 本次核读机构编目与展览说明，未核对 Molnár 全部程序或日记原件。NGA 的铭文差异保持未决；V&A 展览截至核读日尚未开幕。

sections: [{"id":"before-computers","heading":{"zh":"在使用计算机之前","en":"Before access to a computer"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"蓬皮杜中心的回顾展将 Molnár 的实践放回战后几何抽象的脉络。她在真正使用计算机之前就以规则安排图形，提出“想象机器”的方法；1968 年开始借助计算机与绘图机制作图像。重要的区别是：规则化的思考先已存在，取得机器后，执行和比较变化的条件才发生改变。","en":"The Centre Pompidou places Molnár’s practice within post-war geometric abstraction. Rule-based procedures and her imaginary-machine method preceded her use of computers and plotters in 1968. The sequence matters: procedural thinking was already part of her art; access to a machine changed the conditions for executing and comparing variations."}],"sourceIds":["pompidou"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"object","heading":{"zh":"把《Interruptions》作为具体物件阅读","en":"Reading Interruptions as a physical object"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"美国国家美术馆收藏的一件《Interruptions》标年为 1969，材料是 Benson 绘图纸上的黑色墨线，纸张约为 44.45 × 35.88 厘米，登录号为 2018.38.1。这样的记录让作品从“算法艺术先驱”的概括中重新成为有尺度、有纸张和墨迹的物件。机器执行的痕迹也属于作品的物质历史。","en":"An Interruptions drawing in the National Gallery of Art is dated 1969: black ink on Benson plotter paper, approximately 44.45 × 35.88 cm, accession 2018.38.1. These particulars move the discussion from a generic label such as ‘algorithmic pioneer’ to a physical object with a scale, support and inked marks."}],"sourceIds":["nga"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"series","heading":{"zh":"秩序与扰动需要放在系列中看","en":"Order and disturbance across a series"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"蓬皮杜的展览说明把 1970 年代的一组实践联系到几何构图中局部无序的引入，并列出《160 carrés poussés à bout》和《Des lignes, pas des carrés》等系列。阅读时应同时比较保留下来的结构和被改变的部分，而不只寻找机器制造了多少复杂性。","en":"The Pompidou’s account associates a group of 1970s works with disturbances introduced into geometric compositions, including 160 carrés poussés à bout and Des lignes, pas des carrés. A useful way to approach a series is to compare what remains stable with what changes, rather than equating artistic interest with the amount of complexity a machine produces."}],"sourceIds":["pompidou"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"inscriptions","heading":{"zh":"作品日期与纸上的日期不一定只有一个","en":"Object dates and inscriptions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"同一件 NGA 藏品的铭文栏记录了 1969 和 1970 两种年份，而机构采用的作品年份仍为 1969。我们应同时保留机构编目日期和实物铭文，不能自行把后一个年份解释为重印或修订。这是档案研究里的具体问题：编目结论、物件证据与尚未确定的解释需要分开。","en":"The NGA records inscriptions bearing both 1969 and 1970 while retaining 1969 as the object’s catalogue date. Neither a reprint nor a revision can be inferred from the later inscription alone. Keeping catalogue conclusions, material evidence and unresolved interpretation separate is a practical task of archival research."}],"sourceIds":["nga"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reception","heading":{"zh":"后来的展览怎样重新组织这段历史","en":"How later exhibitions frame the practice"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"V&A 公布的“Degrees of Disruption”展览计划把 Molnár 的作品与 Casey Reas、Licia He 等人的实践并置。根据截至 2026 年 10 月 2 日可读的公告，开幕定于 10 月 16 日；这里记录的是展览计划，不是已经发生的观看经验。并置能够提出比较问题，但还不能独自证明艺术家之间存在直接影响链。","en":"The V&A’s announced Degrees of Disruption display places Molnár alongside practitioners including Casey Reas and Licia He. As checked on 2 October 2026, its opening is scheduled for 16 October: this is a curatorial plan, not an account of an exhibition already visited. Juxtaposition can frame a comparison without establishing direct influence."}],"sourceIds":["vam"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"control","heading":{"zh":"对“控制”的另一种理解","en":"Another way to think about control"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：Molnár 提供的比较不是“机器代替了手”，而是艺术家怎样规定一个变化空间，再通过观看决定哪些差异值得继续。把规则写出来不会使判断自动消失。将她放入 AI 艺术的前史，是为了讨论程序化创作的不同道路；这不意味着她的绘图程序就是今天的机器学习模型。","en":"Editorial interpretation: Molnár offers a way to study how artists establish a space of variation and then judge its differences. Making a procedure explicit does not eliminate aesthetic decisions. Her place in an AI-art genealogy allows comparison between computational practices, without retrospectively turning her drawing programs into contemporary machine-learning models."}],"sourceIds":["pompidou","nga"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"transition","heading":{"zh":"从手绘语言转向程序","en":"From a drawn vocabulary to a program"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"bitforms 的展览资料把 Mohr 的转变联系到信息美学和算法音乐：Max Bense 的著作以及他与 Pierre Barbaud 的接触，提供了重新思考抽象形式的背景。1969 年的艺术家书《Artificiata I》仍由手绘完成。这个过渡提醒我们，开始编程并不等于原有的形式问题在一夜之间消失。","en":"The bitforms exhibition account relates Mohr’s transition to information aesthetics and algorithmic music, including Max Bense’s writings and his contact with Pierre Barbaud. His 1969 artist’s book Artificiata I was still drawn by hand. Beginning to program did not erase the formal problems that his earlier work had already raised."}],"sourceIds":["bitforms"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"random-walk","heading":{"zh":"P-18：随机游走也有词汇与边界","en":"P-18: a random walk with a vocabulary"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Mohr 对 P-18 的说明列出水平线、垂直线、45 度线、方波和折线，并为线宽与长度设置概率。程序在一个限定区域中从这些元素里作选择。因此，“随机”不是随意画任何东西，而是在被规定的词汇和空间里推进。艺术家的作品页同时列有纸本绘图与高分辨率微缩胶片输出的例子。","en":"Mohr’s account of P-18 specifies horizontal, vertical and 45-degree lines, square waves and zigzags, with probabilities governing widths and lengths. The program selects from this vocabulary within a bounded area. Randomness therefore operates through defined possibilities. His page also distinguishes a drawing on paper from examples output by a high-resolution microfilm light-beam plotter."}],"sourceIds":["p18"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"infrastructure","heading":{"zh":"计算条件进入作品的生产史","en":"Computing access becomes part of production history"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"在为 1971 年展览图录所作的网上补充说明中，Mohr 回忆早期程序在巴黎 Vincennes 的 SDS 计算机上编写，后续绘图又涉及不同机构的机器。他记述 1970 年起使用巴黎气象机构的 CDC 计算机和 Benson 平板绘图机。这些设备名称不是装饰性的技术背景，而是在说明计算、输出与艺术家的可用资源如何相遇。","en":"In his online annotations to the 1971 catalogue, Mohr recalls writing early programs on an SDS computer at Vincennes and using machines at several institutions. He identifies the CDC computer and Benson flatbed plotter at the Paris meteorological service for drawings from 1970 onwards. Computing and output depended on access to particular institutional resources."}],"sourceIds":["catalogue"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"catalogue","heading":{"zh":"1971 年展览与图录中的黑白反转","en":"The 1971 exhibition and the reversed catalogue images"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"巴黎市立现代艺术博物馆 ARC 的《Une Esthétique Programmée》把程序化绘图带进个展语境。Mohr 特别提醒读者：图录里的白线黑底图像经过摄影反转，原作是白纸上的黑色墨线；而每套算法在图录中仅展示少量样本。不能把一页复制品当成原作的全部材料属性，也不能把一本图录看成程序全部输出的清单。","en":"Une Esthétique Programmée at ARC, Musée d’Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris, gave these drawings a solo-exhibition setting in 1971. Mohr warns that white-on-black reproductions in the catalogue were photographically reversed: the originals were black ink on white paper. The catalogue also selects only a small number of examples from each algorithm rather than documenting every output."}],"sourceIds":["catalogue"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"another-program","heading":{"zh":"另一套程序提出另一种空间问题","en":"A different program, a different spatial problem"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"1972 年的 P-133（cluster phobia）不沿用随机游走的同一规则。Mohr 的作品说明描述先形成带有网格线的区域，再把矩形和折线安置到留下的空间里，整体类似随机的印刷电路。把它与 P-18 并读，可以看到作品之间的差异来自程序所提出的问题，而不只是同一张图的外观变体。","en":"P-133, cluster phobia (1972), does not simply repeat the random-walk procedure. Mohr describes constructing gridded areas and fitting rectangles and broken lines into the remaining spaces, producing a circuit-like arrangement. Comparing it with P-18 makes differences between procedural problems visible, rather than treating all computer drawings as variations of one effect."}],"sourceIds":["p133"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"stakes","heading":{"zh":"程序化并没有取消艺术家的决定","en":"Programming relocates artistic decisions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：这里的创作决定分布在元素选择、约束、概率、设备使用和展示方式中。它帮助我们具体讨论谁组织了图像的生成条件。Mohr 的方法与今天模型训练所涉及的数据许可并不是同一种机制；可比较的是决定权怎样分布，而不是仅凭“都用了计算机”推断同样的作者关系。","en":"Editorial interpretation: decisions are distributed across the vocabulary, constraints, probabilities, equipment and presentation. This offers a concrete way to examine who organises the conditions of generation. The relevant comparison with contemporary AI is the distribution of decisions, not an assumption that every computer-mediated practice shares the same authorship or data-licensing model."}],"sourceIds":["p18","catalogue","p133"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"尺度与形态","en":"Scale and form"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"曼德尔布罗特讨论自然界中难以用光滑几何对象描述的粗糙形态。计算机图形使重复运算得到的复杂结构能够被观察和比较。1975年的法文著作和1982年的《自然的分形几何》是相连但不同的出版节点，本条以组合日期保留这种发展。","en":"Mandelbrot examines rough forms that smooth geometric objects describe poorly. Computer graphics make complex structures produced by repeated operations visible and comparable. The 1975 French work and The Fractal Geometry of Nature in 1982 are related but distinct publications, retained here as a combined chronology."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"生成并不必然是学习","en":"Generation does not necessarily involve learning"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"分形图像为生成艺术提供一种重要对照：丰富的形态可以来自计算规则，而不是从图像数据库学习。制作中的控制包括公式、参数、取景和着色。把本条放入AI艺术的广义背景，是为了辨别这些不同来源的视觉复杂性，并非把所有分形图像重新命名为AI艺术。","en":"Fractal imagery is an important comparison for generative art: rich forms can arise from computational rules without learning an image database. Its presence in this broader genealogy distinguishes sources of visual complexity rather than relabelling every fractal image as AI art."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"历史对象与具体过程","en":"Historical object and process"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Dawkins回忆，Macintosh程序用树状生成算法和一组数值“基因”形成biomorph；使用者选择一个形态，它成为下一轮变化的起点。原作者也谈到后续增加分节和对称等控制。回忆中的个别数量有编辑更正，因此应保留版本差异，而不是固定成所有程序都相同的规格。","en":"Dawkins recalls a Macintosh program generating biomorphs through a tree-growing algorithm and numerical “genes.” A selected form becomes the parent for the next set of variations; later versions add controls including segmentation and symmetry. sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"研究方法与具体变化","en":"Method and contribution"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Rumelhart、Hinton 与 Williams 描述了一种反复调整连接权重的程序，以缩小实际输出与目标输出之间的差异。关键在于中间的隐藏单元能够形成对任务有用的特征，而不必由设计者逐项指定。论文发表于1986年，不能据此把所有梯度学习方法的起点都归给这一篇文章。","en":"Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams describe repeatedly adjusting connection weights to reduce the discrepancy between actual and desired outputs. Hidden units acquire features useful to the task rather than receiving a complete inventory of features from the designer. The 1986 paper demonstrates and explains this procedure; its publication should not be treated as the sole origin of every gradient-based learning method."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"section-2","heading":{"zh":"在艺术史中的位置","en":"Art-historical interpretation"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"它在本档案中属于训练机制的历史背景，而不是一件艺术作品。与手写绘图规则相比，特征可以从训练任务中形成，这使研究重心转向数据、目标函数与训练组织。后来图像模型的视觉习惯如何形成，需要沿这些具体环节追问，而不是把“学习”理解为艺术家式的经验。","en":"This is a history of training mechanisms, not an artwork. Compared with explicitly programming drawing rules, learning intermediate features shifts attention towards datasets, objectives and the organisation of training. Later image models’ visual regularities can be investigated through these mechanisms without equating statistical learning with an artist’s lived experience."}],"sourceIds":["primary"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"不逐只绘制飞行路线","en":"Beyond individually scripted flight paths"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Reynolds 的 1987 年论文把群体运动视为动画问题：如果逐只鸟指定路线，制作复杂群体会非常费力。Boids 将每个个体作为独立行动者，让它依据局部环境、模拟物理和设定行为决定运动。群体形态由个体之间的作用产生。","en":"Reynolds approached flocking as an animation problem. Reynolds places the approach within particle systems and behavioural animation. sections: [{"id":"section-1","heading":{"zh":"让图像材料继续生长","en":"Extending a sample into a new texture"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Efros 与 Freeman 的图像拼接方法直接使用已有图像的小块，寻找能够连贯连接的组合，生成更大的纹理。算法不要求建立物体的三维模型；它面对的是怎样让新结果在视觉上保持样本的材质特征。","en":"Efros and Freeman synthesise a larger texture by joining small patches from existing images. The input is both a sample to analyse and material used in synthesis. sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"台湾科技艺术学会目录记录作品创作年2021，媒材为电脑程序、双频道投影与多声道电子声响，藏所为艺术家自藏。目录说明节录自北美馆新闻稿：观众可下载预测个股现象的程序，作品通过机器学习和用户反馈探索资本市场。北美馆《混沌边界》说明把它与其他自动装置并置，讨论注意力、技术和权力。2022年1月15日至4月17日为展览日程，不能改写作品年；无人机、手机或3D打印装置也不因此全被认定为机器学习作品。","en":"The Taiwan Art & Technology Association dates the work to 2021 and lists software, two-channel projection and multichannel sound. sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"画廊回顾描述《Protest in Colour》从抗议照片生成多个变体，再筛选并手工叠层，图注列2022年档案相纸微喷作品。艺术家在8月1日发表的访谈中将新闻摄影、文艺复兴审美和数字处理联系起来，说明纪念抗议者的意图。展览页列6月16日至7月16日，并把该系列与2021年驻留期间制作的数字拼贴区分。生成过程的版本数量是画廊报告，未独立测试；同场短片和拼贴不能自动归为AI生成。","en":"The gallery retrospective describes generating variants from protest photographs, selecting them and manually layering them into prints. A caption identifies a 2022 giclée on archival photo paper. In an interview published on 1 August, Binoy connects photojournalism, Renaissance aesthetics and digital manipulation with commemorating protesters. The exhibition page lists 16 June–16 July and distinguishes the series from digital collages produced during a 2021 residency. Reported variant counts are not independently tested; neither the accompanying film nor all collages are thereby established as AI-generated."}],"sourceIds":["src-1670","src-1669","src-1671"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：这组作品使AI图像史与抗议图像的流通、审美化及纪念发生联系。生成图像能够改变历史材料的表现方式，却不能成为现场事实的替代证据；照片来源和被摄者同意仍是这条制作链必须回答的问题。","en":"Editorial interpretation: this series connects AI-image history to the circulation and commemoration of protest imagery. Transforming historical material does not turn generated images into evidence of events. Photograph provenance and subjects’ consent remain central questions for the production chain."}],"sourceIds":["src-1670","src-1669","src-1671"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Ng与Page在2026年3月18日的研究文本中说明球形装置：双摄像头和麦克风取得感知片段，语言模型生成短文本并累积为记忆，观众从孔径读取内部屏幕。作品不提供常规指令界面，创作者报告有人抱持、展示或担忧其观察他人。NCM展览页另列4月22日至8月9日。文本发表日不当创作首日，馆方“过去展览”标签也不是整个展期运行的独立核验。","en":"In their research text dated 18 March 2026, Ng and Page describe a reflective orb whose cameras and microphone feed fragments to an LLM. Publication does not date the work’s invention; a past-exhibition label does not independently verify continuous operation."}],"sourceIds":["src-1652","src-1651"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：它将生成艺术的对象从输出内容转向观察关系、身体距离和界面角色。孔径及延迟阅读让观看成为有限、局部的接触；这既提供形式分析线索，也要求考察摄录、留存与旁观者同意。","en":"Editorial interpretation: the object shifts attention from generated content to bodily distance and roles of observation. sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"导演与Filmatters讨论以栋多夫印刷厂及家族历史为线索的2026年影片。CLIP界面用于寻找资料关系，与生成或修改图像的模型分开。导演将当代合唱团的记忆实践和纪录片拍摄引入影片；声音重构使用今日样本，不是寻回历史录音。访谈把算法建议、档案缺席与历史研究的责任放在一起，不能把艺术家的偏差例子当作独立模型实验。德英版本的日期已对照，7月6日为访谈刊日，不是首映或委约日。","en":"The director and Filmatters discuss a 2026 film tracing the Dondorf printing house and family. A CLIP interface explores connections between materials, separately from models generating or modifying images. Contemporary choral commemoration enters documentary filming; reconstructed sound uses present-day samples rather than recovered historical recordings. The interview connects algorithmic suggestions with archival absence and research responsibility. Its publication on 6 July is distinct from a premiere or commission date. Reported model biases are not independent experiments."}],"sourceIds":["src-1657","src-1658"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：影片提出的关键不只是生成能力，而是何时保留缺席、何时明确暴露合成。把相似性检索与历史解释分开，有助于判断一个图像是资料、研究工具还是艺术加工，也使档案机构的劳动可见。","en":"Editorial interpretation: the issue is when to preserve absence and when to disclose synthesis. Distinguishing similarity retrieval from historical explanation helps separate evidence, research tools and artistic transformations, while making archival labour visible."}],"sourceIds":["src-1657","src-1658"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"节展页列2026年10月8日开幕，10月17日采访者称参加了开幕。艺术家描述三只熊与彼此及访客对话，并设计不同的衰退轨迹。虽然对话不是预写脚本，角色与安全边界仍由提示设定；临展前为缩短响应时间换系统，又改变了声音与个性。节展说明对话会自动转写，匿名片段可能用于后续艺术研究。无脚本不能等同于无创作者控制，系统衰退的艺术构想也不是机器意识或产业消亡的证明。","en":"The programme lists an opening on 8 October 2026; an interviewer writing on 17 October reports attending it. Rosenbaum describes three bears conversing with visitors and each other, with differing trajectories of decline. Unscripted dialogue still relies on governing prompts and safety boundaries. A system change shortly before exhibition reduced response time but altered voices and personalities. The programme discloses automatic transcription and possible later use of anonymised excerpts. These arrangements distinguish conversational unpredictability from an absence of artistic control."}],"sourceIds":["src-1649","src-1650"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：陪伴与消逝在此由实体、对话节奏和服务依赖共同构成。把技术延迟和替换纳入作品史，比仅将它归为聊天机器人更能解释其形式；转写安排也使观众参与与研究伦理成为作品的制度条件。","en":"Editorial interpretation: physical presence, conversational timing and service dependence shape attachment and loss. Treating latency and replacement as part of the work’s history explains its form more precisely than a chatbot label. Transcription also makes research ethics a condition of participation."}],"sourceIds":["src-1649","src-1650"],"interpretation":true}]

limits.en: The artist’s work statement was read; the returned extract has an acquisition date of 16 July 2026, not a live observation on 13 November. sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"主办方列6月3–12日为2022展期，地点语境为伊斯坦布尔Fişekhane，并把视频、声音、装置、摄影与表演纳入讨论。网页分别署Avind策展、Bager Akbay艺术总监、Esra Özkan展览协调；场地方用共同策展描述这些角色。主办名单及目录列13个艺术家或组合，场地方列12项，这一差异不应被抹平。目录前言把AI会使用何种策展标准写成问题，而非公开可复现的选择程序。","en":"The organiser lists 3–12 June 2022 and frames the festival at Fişekhane in Istanbul around video, sound, installation, photography and performance. sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"《Centaur》由Pontus Lidberg编舞，Cecilie Waagner Falkenstrøm及技术团队制作AI装置，Ryoji Ikeda负责声音与视觉设计。合作艺术家将作品标为2020年，说明系统使用排练中采集的动作数据，通过LSTM生成动作组合，另以规则组织群体互动，并以合成声音向舞者发出指令。这是创作者对制作方式的说明，不是独立的代码或现场运行测试。作品借人马混合体讨论创作者与所造系统的关系，不能据舞台角色赋予机器意识。后续传播不能合并成一次首演：艺术家明确列2021年巴黎场次取消；团方年报的马德里排期为2022年4月1—3日，但统计表记预算3场、实际2场。智利合作页记线上观看，不证明舞团赴智利现场巡演。","en":"Pontus Lidberg choreographed Centaur; Cecilie Waagner Falkenstrøm and the technical team developed its AI installation, and Ryoji Ikeda provided audio and visual design. The collaborating artist dates the work to 2020 and describes movement captured in rehearsal, LSTM-generated combinations, rules for group interaction and a synthetic voice issuing instructions. This is a maker’s account, not an independent test of code or live operation. The hybrid figure stages a relationship between creators and their system; its theatrical agency does not establish machine consciousness. Later circulation cannot be collapsed into a premiere: the artist explicitly lists the 2021 Paris cancellation. The company’s report gives Madrid dates of 1–3 April 2022 but records three budgeted and two actual performances. A Chilean partner page describes online viewing, not a live company tour in Chile."}],"sourceIds":["src-2064","src-2065","src-2066"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：这一作品把AI艺术的问题从图像输出转向排练、身体数据和舞台协商。算法能够提出什么、舞者选择接受什么、技术团队怎样预先设定任务，构成不同层次的作者性。其历史意义在于编舞与数据处理被放进同一制作过程，而不是证明机器可以取代编舞者。研究仍需把动作采集许可、具体演出版本和实际反馈机制补齐；年报中的场数差异尤其提醒我们，节目预告与实施记录必须分开。","en":"Editorial interpretation: the work shifts attention from generated images to rehearsal, bodily data and negotiation on stage. Algorithmic proposals, dancers’ choices and tasks established by the technical team constitute different layers of authorship. Its historical significance lies in bringing choreography and data processing into one production process, rather than proving that machines can replace choreographers. Movement-data permissions, performance-specific versions and the implemented feedback mechanism remain research questions. The discrepancy in the annual report makes the separation of programmes and delivery records particularly important."}],"sourceIds":["src-2064","src-2065","src-2066"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"艺术家的2021年作品记录将《Reasonable Music (Abilify)》列为七声道声音装置、含电子元件的三维打印物、双通道影像及定制软件。文字说明称先从《道德经》筛选名词和可作名词的动词，再用TensorFlow实现生成过程，将输出继续抽象成声音、现场图像和形态。Art Jameel与Kochi-Muziris双年展、Burger Collection共同委托作品；Jameel官方页明确说不同场地呈现不同迭代，并列迪拜版本自2021年10月30日起展示。大学成果目录所列2022年12月12日Kochi条目是另一层传播记录，不证明其实际安装日或与迪拜配置完全一致。","en":"The artist’s 2021 record describes a seven-channel sound installation, printed objects with embedded electronics, two-channel video and custom software. It explains that nouns and verbs functioning as nouns were selected from the Daodejing for a generative process implemented with TensorFlow; outputs were further abstracted into sound, live images and shapes. Art Jameel commissioned the work with the Kochi-Muziris Biennale and Burger Collection. Jameel explicitly describes different venue iterations and lists its Dubai presentation from 30 October 2021. A university catalogue’s Kochi entry dated 12 December 2022 is a later circulation record, not proof of the installation date or an identical technical configuration."}],"sourceIds":["src-1974","src-1976","jameel-room-2021"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：作品的重要性不在“AI理解道家思想”，而在于它让文本从语言结构转为感官材料，并暴露多次转换中的选择、损失与新生形式。人决定筛选什么、怎样训练和如何把文字映射为物件；生成并没有取消这些决定。跨机构委托与不同场地迭代也使模型、软件、声音和三维输出成为需要保存的版本关系。网页宣称代码和模型可依CC BY 4.0再利用，但研究仍需逐项核查实际资源、文本版本与许可，不能把一条开放声明当成所有输入权利均已解决。","en":"Editorial interpretation: the work matters not because it demonstrates an AI understanding Daoist thought, but because language becomes sensory material through a series of selective transformations. People choose what to filter, how to train and how to map text into objects; generation does not remove those decisions. Joint commissioning and venue-specific iterations also make the relationship between models, software, sound and printed outputs a preservation question. The artist’s website announces reuse under CC BY 4.0, but the actual resources, textual edition and item-specific permissions still require examination; an open-source statement does not settle all input rights."}],"sourceIds":["src-1974","src-1976","jameel-room-2021"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"主办方将2026年11月13日的AI Music Awards设于洛杉矶The Mayan，提名页把经其Registry核验的创作者设为投票群体，强调披露而非自动检测，并限制给自己的作品投票。多数奖项由创作者决定，Off the Charts Spotlight则由SIQA团队决定，不能把所有奖项归为同一种评选。提名页仍含直播占位与预告文字，因此不能单独证明典礼举办或最终得奖。Reuters于11月14日的事后报道补充举办与结果证据；本档案读到AOL转载版本，原站访问限制单独记录，不把转载当作独立的第二家报道。","en":"SIQA scheduled the AI Music Awards at The Mayan in Los Angeles on 13 November 2026. Creators decide most categories, while the SIQA team selects the Off the Charts Spotlight award; the procedures are not identical across all categories. A Reuters retrospective dated 14 November supplies occurrence and results evidence. The archive read its AOL syndication; access limits at the original site are recorded, and the syndication is not treated as an independent second report."}],"sourceIds":["src-2033","src-2034"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：这个节点关注评选制度，而不是把奖杯当作技术进步证据。登记资格、AI参与程度的分类、提名和投票把“谁可以被视为艺术家”转为组织规则，也使创作者、平台与观众之间产生新的认可关系。这些规则为研究生成音乐的接受史提供具体材料；它们是否可信、怎样审核输入权利、收入如何分配，则不能由主办方品牌或活动举办直接推出。本档案不采用“全球首个”宣传，也不据此推定其他奖项或整个音乐行业认可AI作品。","en":"Editorial interpretation: this node concerns an institution of recognition rather than treating awards as proof of technical progress. Registration, categories of AI participation, nomination and voting turn the question of who counts as an artist into organisational rules. The rules’ reliability, input-rights checks and revenue distribution cannot be established from the organiser’s branding or from the ceremony’s occurrence. sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"2026年11月13日的日语原公告介绍PIXTA与ByteDance日本公司的合作：Seedance提供影像生成工具，Anipops提供短动画发布与传播渠道，双方拟向创作者、制作公司和媒体推广，并招募漫画、小说及角色等原作IP合作。公告同时回顾Anipops从2026年3月投稿平台到8月全球分发服务的变化，原投稿功能由Anipops Creators承接。这些是公司对服务与合作安排的说明；推广目标不等于已经完成的制作规模、付费表现或创作者收益。","en":"The Japanese announcement of 13 November 2026 describes a partnership between PIXTA and ByteDance Japan: Seedance supplies video-generation tools and Anipops a channel for short-animation distribution, with outreach to creators, production companies and media and invitations to collaborate around manga, novels and character IP. The announcement also traces Anipops from a submission platform launched in March 2026 to a global distribution service in August, with submissions continuing through Anipops Creators. These are company descriptions of arrangements and services; promotional aims do not establish delivered production scale, paid demand or creator income."}],"sourceIds":["src-2031"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：生成工具与发布平台结合，使技术史问题延伸到作品怎样获得市场入口、何种IP被选择、谁控制制作流程以及如何分配收入。这个节点与单独的Seedance发布记录互补：前者记录组织关系，后者记录工具变化。需要继续追踪实际作品、合同、训练授权和劳动分工，才能判断合作如何改变动画生产。仅凭公告不能确认作者同意、合理报酬或劳动替代效果，也不能把平台拥有分发渠道等同于拥有所有输入素材权利。","en":"Editorial interpretation: linking generation and distribution extends technical history into questions of market access, IP selection, production control and revenue allocation. The announcement alone does not establish consent, fair remuneration or labour displacement, and control of distribution does not establish rights to every input."}],"sourceIds":["src-2031"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"2018年6月22日，Dazed发表Thomas Gorton对Ash Koosha的采访，并首次在该媒体推出Yona的《Oblivious》。Koosha介绍的软件分别生成句子、MIDI旋律及文本转歌声，他负责最终混音与制作。文章中的Yona问答是虚构角色的呈现，不能当作机器具有主观经验的证据。巴比肯艺术中心2019年8月23日的节目另列Ash Koosha与Isabella Winthrop为创作者，将讨论及多媒体表演纳入《AI：超越人类》的相关活动。2020年FACT回顾称项目起于2017年的声音乐器实验，并描述后来使用GPT及按虚构人格选择训练材料的过程；这些后期技术不能反向当作2018年版本的完整规格。","en":"On 22 June 2018 Dazed published Thomas Gorton’s interview with Ash Koosha and premiered Yona’s Oblivious on its platform. Koosha described software generating sentences, MIDI melodies and singing through text-to-speech, with his own mixing and production completing the track. The staged interview with Yona presents a fictional persona, not evidence of machine subjective experience. A separate Barbican programme for 23 August 2019 credits Ash Koosha and Isabella Winthrop and places discussion and multimedia performance alongside AI: More than Human. FACT’s 2020 retrospective traces the project to a 2017 voice-instrument experiment and describes later GPT use and material selected for a fictional personality. These later techniques cannot be treated as a complete specification of the 2018 version."}],"sourceIds":["yona-dazed-2018","yona-barbican-2019","yona-fact-2020"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：Yona的重要性在于把多个生成过程、人的制作判断和虚拟表演者形象组织到同一作品中。以虚拟歌手署名容易掩盖混音、选材和角色设计的劳动，机构节目则显示这些问题怎样进入公共艺术讨论。此节点不是“首位AI歌手”的全球优先权判断，也不把软件拟人化等同于自主作者。","en":"Editorial interpretation: Yona matters as an arrangement of multiple generative processes, human production decisions and a virtual performer’s identity. Crediting a fictional singer can obscure mixing, material selection and persona-design labour; institutional programming shows how these questions entered public discussion of art. This node makes no global priority claim for a first AI singer and does not equate personification with autonomous authorship."}],"sourceIds":["yona-dazed-2018","yona-barbican-2019","yona-fact-2020"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"云门2023年10月11日公告将《波》列入成立五十周年的新作，预告12日起在台北、台中及高雄演出。真锅大度团队使用摄影机与肌电感应器采集舞者数据，生成材料为编舞提供动作可能性；郑宗龙强调自己的编排判断，而不是把编舞全部交给AI。台北表演艺术中心2024年刊出的Kathy Hong制作回顾将合作讨论追溯到2021年、东京会面列为2022年、台湾数据采集列为2023年2月。她明确说明，为适应巡演的装台及排练时间，舞台影像与音乐在演出前完成，演出时不运行现场AI；台北剧院大厅的观众动作影像互动是另一个环节。","en":"Cloud Gate’s announcement of 11 October 2023 introduces WAVES in its fiftieth-anniversary season and schedules performances from 12 October in Taipei, Taichung and Kaohsiung. Manabe’s team used cameras and electromyography sensors to collect dancer data; generated material supplied movement possibilities for Cheng’s choreographic decisions rather than replacing them. A 2024 Taipei Performing Arts Center account of Kathy Hong’s production presentation dates discussions to 2021, a Tokyo meeting to 2022 and data collection in Taiwan to February 2023. Hong explicitly says that visuals and music were finalised before shows to meet touring constraints, without live AI during stage performances. Audience-motion interaction in the Taipei theatre foyer was a separate component."}],"sourceIds":["src-2190","src-2191","src-2192"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：《波》把生成技术放进成熟舞团的排练、制作与巡演制度中。其意义不只在出现AI影像，还在艺术家和工程师如何转换动作语言、决定何处保留不可预测性、何处将媒体固定下来。区分创作阶段、舞台播放和大厅互动，能避免把所有技术环节都称为“实时AI编舞”。","en":"Editorial interpretation: WAVES places generative techniques within an established company’s rehearsal, production and touring structures. Its significance concerns how artists and engineers translate movement language and decide where unpredictability remains useful and where media must be fixed. Separating development, stage playback and foyer interaction prevents every technical component from being described as real-time AI choreography."}],"sourceIds":["src-2190","src-2191","src-2192"],"interpretation":true}]

sections: [{"id":"work","heading":{"zh":"作品、机构与日期","en":"Work, institution and date"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"Alexandra Miller Sickert与Jaime San Martín Amador把动作捕捉、AI和摄影测量用于舞者的数字化形象，再让真人解释机器变换后的动作。MAC的项目文字把这个过程描述为双向翻译：某些错误或身体无法完成的动作，会迫使表演者寻找新的语言。原节目列MAC Quinta Normal及CEINA等场地；CEINA年报将该作记入2024年10月，并自报观众126。这个数值不是独立去重人数或每场人数，年报也没有给出每场日期。Diego Parra Donoso在2025年4月的具名评论中记述自己在CEINA观看后的不适参与体验，批评技术新颖性与模仿之间的关系。评论发布日期不是观看日期，个人反应也不代表观众共识。","en":"Alexandra Miller Sickert and Jaime San Martín Amador combine motion capture, AI and photogrammetry in digital representations of dancers, then ask human performers to interpret the transformed movements. MAC’s project text describes a two-way translation: errors and physically impossible gestures prompt performers to seek another movement language. The programme names MAC Quinta Normal and CEINA among the venues. CEINA’s annual report lists the work in October 2024 and reports an audience of 126, without establishing unique visitors, a per-show denominator or exact dates for every performance. In an April 2025 signed review, Diego Parra Donoso describes his experience at CEINA and questions technical novelty through uneasy audience participation and imitation. Publication does not date his visit, and one response is not audience consensus."}],"sourceIds":["src-2193","src-2196","src-2197"],"interpretation":false},{"id":"reading","heading":{"zh":"艺术史意义与问题","en":"Historical significance and questions"},"paragraphs":[{"zh":"编者解释：作品不是用数字角色简单取代演员，而是把身体如何模仿经过计算改写的自己变成观看问题。博物馆、文化中心、项目说明和批评文章分别提供不同的解释场景。把创作者的过程自述与评论者的观看经验并列，可以保留作品的争议，而不是把“使用AI”自动当成艺术创新的证明。","en":"Editorial interpretation: the work does not simply replace performers with digital figures; it makes the body’s imitation of its computationally altered self a problem of spectatorship. Museum and cultural-centre presentations, production descriptions and criticism supply different interpretive settings.
